snippet.title: Feeding Frenzy Trailer
snippet.description:
Download Free: http://www.gamefools.com/pc-games/feeding-frenzy.html

It's the ultimate survival of the biggest in this action-packed deep sea challenge. Eat your way to the top of the food chain as you swim through stunning underwater environments and encounter deadly predators. Look out for the power-ups, mermaids, and bonus stages that you will need to help you on your quest to unseat the vicious Shark King.
